content: Access a wide range of AI models through OpenRouter. To run a model on your own provider key, connect it in <1>BYOK</1>.

comment.text: Description on the AI models tab of the AI settings page when no own key is connected. OpenRouter is a product name; <1>BYOK</1> wraps a link to the BYOK tab, keep the tag and the acronym BYOK untranslated.
